description: Use to find a public geophysics or terrain grid to read values from: GA's national gravity, magnetics (TMI, RTP, 1VD...), radiometrics, isostatic residuals, SGTool products and DEM, and GSWA's WA Moho and scanned geological map mosaics. Returns each grid's raster_id, family, name, title, bounds, colour stretch and unit. Pass the raster_id to sample_raster or describe_raster.

q.description: Words in the title, name or family (e.g. "moho", "rtp"); empty lists all.

name: list_geophysics_grids
title: List geophysics and terrain grids
